Fenced garden with security at the main gates; paths are unlit, so leave as the light goes and park inside the Olifants Road gate rather than on the street.
Fenced, staffed and ticketed with a single entrance and secure parking; the ridge trail is rocky and exposed, so carry water and stay on marked paths.
Open, unfenced park with busy roads on three sides and no lighting on the lawns after dark; treat it as a daytime and golden-hour spot and be off the grass by dusk.

spots.name: Bukit Jalil Recreational Park (Taman Rekreasi Bukit Jalil)

safety.note: Large park with unlit interior paths and slopes and few exits once you are on the ridge; gates close at 8pm, so stay on the lit loop near the entrance after dusk or leave before dark.

spots.name: Ilham Gallery
spots.hours: Tue-Sat 11am-6pm, Sun 11am-5pm, closed Mon and public holidays

safety.note: Staffed gallery inside a guarded office tower; surrounding streets are lit and busy with office traffic.
Staffed public building with bag checks; the square outside is lit and open but empties after the library closes.

spots.name: National Art Gallery (Balai Seni Negara)
spots.hours: Tue-Sun 10am-6pm, closed Mon and public holidays

safety.note: Staffed public building; the walk from Titiwangsa station follows a wide, fast road with long gaps between crossings, so use the signalled crossings.

Forest trails are unlit, steep in places and slippery after rain, with patchy phone signal off the main loop; go in daylight, tell someone your route and stay on named trails. Macaques are common, so keep food packed away.
Gated, staffed park with marked, signposted trails that closes before dark; paths are unlit and slippery after rain, so go in daylight and stick to the marked loops.
Staffed venue on a lit, busy pedestrian street until late; the old cinema stairs are steep and uneven, so mind your footing on the upper levels.

spots.name: Islamic Arts Museum Malaysia
spots.hours: 9:30am-6pm daily (9:30am-5pm in Ramadan; closed Hari Raya)

safety.note: Staffed, ticketed museum; the walk from the station passes under a highway ramp, so use the pavement past the National Mosque.

spots.name: KL Forest Eco Park (Bukit Nanas Forest Reserve)
spots.hours: 7am-7pm, closed Fri (RM10 MyKad / RM40 others, cash)

safety.note: Staffed, ticketed reserve that closes at 7pm; boardwalks and canopy walk are slippery when wet and the canopy walk shuts in storms. Macaques will grab food and loose bags.
Staffed cafe on a lit, busy street; the stairwell is steep and the courtyard floor gets wet in rain.
Large, patrolled and well used by joggers; the lakeside paths are lit but the inner garden paths are not, so leave the wooded sections before dusk. Macaques take unattended food.

Well-lit and busy in the evening with steady foot traffic; the approach paths beside the elevated highway are quieter and less overlooked late at night, so cross while people are still about and plan the walk back to the LRT or a ride.
Staffed temple grounds, lit until closing; the access road up the hill has no continuous pavement and little traffic after dark, so plan a ride down rather than walking.
Lit promenade busy into the evening with joggers and families; the water edge is mostly unfenced on the boardwalks, and the inner lawns are darker, so stay on the lit loop after dark.
Rural lanes with no streetlights; ideal for dawn and dusk, but head back toward Saga-Arashiyama station before it is fully dark.
Fine at dusk with other walkers around, but the hill paths are unlit; after dark go with a friend and carry a light, or stick to the shrine steps.

spots.name: Higashiyama Cube Terrace (Kyocera Museum of Art rooftop)
spots.hours: 10am-6pm, closed Mon (follows museum hours; check site)

safety.note: Staffed museum; daytime only.
Staffed public building in the museum district.
Quiet residential streets; no concerns.
Quiet residential park; paths are unlit in places after dark, so it is best as a daytime and dusk spot.
Closes at 4pm; daytime only.
Populated until late; the bank is only partly lit after dark but there are usually locals around and the road above is well lit.

spots.name: Keibunsha Ichijoji

safety.note: Residential neighbourhood; no concerns.
Gated garden, daytime only.
Street-lit lane with residents and diners around until late; the busier bar stretch south of Sanjo is louder and has touts, but is still a populated public street.
Lit main paths and a steady stream of joggers and families into the evening.
Open 24h; the perimeter roads are lit but interior avenues are dark at night, so it is best as a day and dusk spot.

spots.name: Kyoto Station Sky Garden and Skyway
spots.hours: Sky Garden roughly 6am-11pm; Skyway shorter (check site)

safety.note: Well lit, staffed station building; open until late.

spots.name: Alliance Française de Lagos (Mike Adenuga Centre)
spots.hours: varies (reception Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-2pm; cafe from 7am; check site)

safety.note: Gated compound with security at the entrance and staff on site; the cafe stays open into the evening and the forecourt is lit.

spots.name: Jazzhole
spots.hours: varies (listings disagree; roughly 9:30am-7pm or later Mon-Sat, Sunday uncertain; check Instagram)

safety.note: Staffed shop on a main, lit road served by taxis and ride-hailing; parking on Awolowo Road is tight, so arrive by car with a plan to be dropped off.

spots.name: John Randle Centre for Yoruba Culture and History
spots.wikipediaTitle: John Randle Centre for Yoruba Culture and History

safety.note: Staffed, ticketed building with a gated compound; closes at 6pm, before dark.
Staffed private museum behind a gate on a residential street; closes at 6pm, and the walk back to Allen Avenue is short and along a lit main road.
Inside a staffed, secured shopping mall with its own car park; closes before dark.

Open-water boat crossing with no fixed schedule and no lifeguards on the beach; the ocean side has a strong undertow, so swim only in the sheltered bay, wear a life jacket on the boat and be back at the landing an hour before dusk.

spots.name: University of Lagos Lagoon Front
spots.hours: campus open by day (visitor access varies)

safety.note: Inside a gated, policed campus; the lagoon wall is low and unfenced with deep water below, and the shore path is unlit, so go in daylight and stay on the paved side.
Walled, gated and staffed, with lit paths in the evening; after closing the surrounding business streets are quiet and mostly unlit, so arrange your ride from the gate.
Fenced park with gate staff, next to the state secretariat and its police post; it closes at 6pm and has little lighting inside, so be at the gate before closing and plan the ride from there.
Gated, staffed reserve that closes before dusk; the boardwalk has railings but is slippery when wet, and the canopy walkway is high and sways, so skip it if you dislike heights.
Fenced, gated and staffed, with lighting until the 8pm close; the surrounding streets are busy office streets by day and quieter after offices shut.
Staffed building with a gated forecourt and security; closes before dark.
Staffed building with a gated car park and security at the door; open into the evening on a busy street.

spots.name: Lekki-Ikoyi Link Bridge walkway
spots.hours: 24h for traffic; walkway used mornings and evenings (access varies)

safety.note: A narrow walkway beside fast traffic with no shade and a long drop to the water; pedestrian access is sometimes closed by the authorities. Walk it in daylight or the lit early evening, stay inside the barrier, and turn back if the ramp is barred.

Daylight only: the reserve closes at 5pm and the boardwalks run beside open water channels with no railings in places. Stay on the marked trails, wear closed shoes and arrange your return transport before the last turn ends.
Staffed public building with security at the entrance; bags are checked and lockers are provided.
Staffed building on a busy pedestrian street beside the Government Palace; leave via Jr. Áncash or Jr. Carabaya towards Plaza Mayor, which stay lit and policed after closing.
Staffed shop and café on a residential street a block from the Parque Municipal and its taxis; closes by 8pm.
Staffed, fenced archaeological site open only in daylight; the adobe ramp has no handrail and is slippery when damp.

Lit promenade with a low sea wall and stone beach; waves break onto the rocks in swell, so keep off the wet stones. Plan the ride home in advance, since the peninsula empties after dark and is a long way from Lima.
Fenced park with a guard at the gate, closed overnight; lit paths and a busy avenue outside.
Open, well-lit park with municipal serenazgo patrols and streets on all sides; paths are gravel and uneven in places.
Staffed shop on a lit, busy Miraflores street; open late.
Gated, staffed grounds with taxis easy to call from the entrance; the surrounding streets are residential and dimly lit at night, so book a ride rather than walking to Av. Brasil.
Fenced, lit and gated park with guards at the entrance, closed overnight; the lake edge is unfenced, so watch small children.
Fenced park with guards at the gates, closed overnight; leave via Paseo Colón, which is lit and busy, and use the Estación Central Metropolitano stop next door.

spots.name: Parque María Reiche (Malecón de la Marina)

safety.note: Lit promenade with railings along the cliff edge and joggers until late; stay on the paved paths, since the cliff face below is loose and the stairs down to the Costa Verde are unlit after dark.
Lit, residential street with a kiosk open into the evening; quiet but not isolated.
Gated park, daytime only; some upper corners are secluded, so stick to the main lawns if alone.
Staffed public building in a busy area.
Gated with posted hours; lit paths, but it empties quickly after dark.

spots.name: Jardim do Torel

safety.note: Residential hill, quiet in the evening; the funicular stops running in the evening (around 8pm), so plan the walk down.
Lit residential square with cafes open into the evening.
Lit promenade and Cascais-line trains until late; the sand itself is dark after sunset, so stay on the promenade if lingering.

spots.name: Terraços do Centro Cultural de Belém

spots.name: Jardim Gulbenkian
spots.hours: daily, roughly 10am-6pm, later in summer (check site)

safety.note: Gated, staffed grounds; daytime only.

spots.name: Ler Devagar

spots.wikipediaTitle: Museum of the Order of St John

spots.name: Brown Hart Gardens
spots.hours: Daily approx 8am-8pm (shorter in winter; cafe daytime only)

spots.name: The Hill Garden and Pergola
spots.hours: 8:30am to around dusk (closing time varies by month; check City of London site)

safety.note: Gated garden that closes at dusk; the walk from the tube is along a residential road.

spots.name: The Tide, Greenwich Peninsula
spots.hours: Open daily as part of the estate's public realm; no gate hours published, so treat it as an early-to-evening spot

safety.note: Lit, managed estate with security presence; the walk back to North Greenwich station is short and busy.

spots.name: Wellcome Collection Reading Room

safety.note: Staffed museum building on Euston Road.

spots.name: Dalston Eastern Curve Garden
spots.hours: Daily; seasonal, roughly late morning to dusk in winter and to 9-10pm on summer evenings (check site)

safety.note: Staffed garden with a cafe-bar, lantern-lit until closing; Dalston Lane outside is busy and well lit.
Gated park in a well-policed office district; closes at dusk.
Gated City of London garden in a busy office district; closes at dusk.

The main diagonal path is lit but the open slopes are not; after dark stick to the lit path between the Torshov and Sinsen ends.

spots.name: Tronsmo bokhandel

spots.name: Botanisk hage (Tøyen)

Staffed park with marked trails, but the paths are unlit and steep in places and the gates close at 4:30pm; go in the morning, stay on the trails and carry water.
Lit, overlooked by apartment blocks and next to a busy avenue; fine solo by day and in the early evening.
Staffed museum with a fenced outdoor park; the surrounding causeway path is lit but exposed, so plan transport back after closing.
Ranger-controlled gate and a shared one-way road with no pavement; the road is unlit and the gate closes at 6pm, so start down well before then and walk facing traffic.

spots.name: Museo del Canal Interoceánico

Gated public garden that locks at closing; family-friendly and calm during opening hours.

spots.name: Garden of the Musée de la Vie romantique

Gated and closed after dark; well used by runners and walkers in daylight.

Staffed shop on a lit, busy commercial street with late-running buses.
Staffed venue open in daylight only; the grounds are gated after closing.

Staffed public building with security.

Lit and patrolled until closing; use the signalled crossing on Columbus Blvd after dark.

Busy commercial stretch of Germantown Ave during opening hours.

Calm neighborhood park; the sunken garden has lit paths and a community center nearby, but it is quiet after dark.
Neighborhood park with dog walkers until dusk; unlit after dark, so treat it as a daylight-to-sunset spot.
Lively on summer evenings; away from the bridge piers the riverbank is unlit, so keep to the lawn after sunset.
Well used by walkers and cyclists; the gate closes at 9pm, so plan sunset visits accordingly.

Family park that goes quiet after dark; paths around the lake are lit but the park empties by late evening.

Car-free, well lit, and used by MAX riders and cyclists into the night; the South Waterfront side has cafes and people around.

Busy and friendly at sunset; the paved reservoir loop is lit but the wooded trails are not, so stick to the loop after dark.
Safe and popular; the road up is narrow and unlit, so drive or ride rather than walk it after dark.

Gated park with daytime hours; gates close in the evening.
Residential lane, lit but very quiet after dark.
Public park with lamp-lit paths and people around until late in summer; the island is small and exits are on the bridge.

Busy and lit along the main paths; the lawn itself is dark after the sun sets.

Indoor venue on a quiet street; well lit and staffed until closing.

spots.name: Wallenstein Garden (Valdštejnská zahrada)

spots.name: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Park
spots.wikipediaTitle: Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Classical Chinese Garden

safety.note: Gated daytime park — it locks at dusk, so plan to be out before then. The narrow side streets around it are dim once the shops close; walk out along the lit blocks of Pender or Keefer.
Seawall is well lit and busy until late; the island itself has no lights, so move to the plaza benches after dark.
Staffed shop on a busy Chinatown block; the area quiets after dark.
Public park reached by a road overpass over the rail line; well used by dog walkers and swimmers in daylight, dim after dark.

spots.name: Nitobe Memorial Garden
spots.hours: Apr-Oct daily ~10am-4:30pm; reduced winter days (check site)

safety.note: Fenced campus garden, open daytime only.
Staffed indoor space in a lit, busy part of the park.

spots.name: Lonsdale Quay & Burrard Dry Dock Pier

safety.note: Lit, busy waterfront with SeaBus service until after midnight.
Unlit and very quiet after 10pm. Fine for stargazing with a friend and a headlamp; otherwise leave by dusk.
Stanley Park trails and roads are unlit after dark; return along the seawall with a friend or leave at dusk.
Loop path is only partly lit; busy with joggers and dog walkers until dusk, quiet after.
Busy, well-lit stretch of Commercial Drive; the cafe closes at 6pm.

spots.name: Vancouver Public Library Central Branch rooftop garden
spots.hours: Mon-Thu 9:30am-8:30pm; Fri-Sat 9:30am-6pm; Sun 10am-6pm (rooftop may close earlier; check site)

safety.note: Staffed public building in the busy downtown core; surrounding blocks quiet down after closing.
Summit plaza and parking area are lit and used by locals well into the evening; the lower garden paths are not lit.

spots.name: Botanischer Garten der Universität Wien
spots.hours: varies by season, roughly 10am-dusk (9:30am-7:30pm May-Aug; check site)
spots.wikipediaTitle: Botanical Garden of the University of Vienna

safety.note: Fenced, staffed garden that closes at dusk; sloping gravel paths, so mind your footing after rain.
Unfenced pond edges and narrow steep bridges, and the paths are unlit, so treat it as a daylight-to-dusk spot; the U6 stop is a five-minute walk.
Small fenced garden on a quiet residential street, gated and closed at the posted hours; paths and stepping stones are slippery when wet.
Unlit meadows and woodland paths with no staff and a 15-minute walk to the nearest bus stop; go in daylight or leave at dusk, and wear proper shoes as the tracks are muddy after rain.

spots.name: Türkenschanzpark
spots.hours: open all day (paths unlit after dark)

safety.note: Well-used residential park with lit main paths; the slopes and steps are steep and slippery when wet, and side paths are unlit after dark.

spots.name: Zentralfriedhof
spots.hours: varies by season, roughly 7am-6pm (to 8pm May-Aug, 8am-5pm Nov-Feb); gates locked at closing

safety.note: Gated, staffed and closed overnight; it is very large and mostly unlit, so keep an eye on the closing time and the distance back to the gate you came in by.

spots.name: Augarten
spots.hours: roughly 6am-dusk (later in summer, gates locked at night)

safety.note: Walled and gated park that is locked overnight; the main avenues are lit but the side paths are not, so leave before the gates close.

Unlit beyond the bridge areas, with unfenced banks and fast current on the main Danube side; stay on the Neue Donau side, swim only where marked and head back towards the U-Bahn before it gets fully dark.
Lit towpath with a steady flow of cyclists and walkers; the stone quay edge is unfenced, so keep off the lower steps in the dark or when wet.
Staffed public building directly above a U-Bahn station on a busy, well-lit square; the outdoor staircase is steep and closes with the library.
Staffed venue open late on a lit main street next to the U2; nothing to note.
Staffed museum on a lit central square with U-Bahn access; nothing to note.

spots.name: Café Sperl
spots.hours: roughly Mon-Sat 7am-10pm, Sun 11am-8pm; often closed Sun in Jul-Aug (check site)

safety.note: Staffed cafe on a lit, busy street a few minutes from the U2; nothing to note.

spots.name: MuseumsQuartier courtyards
spots.hours: courtyards open daily until late (venue hours vary; check site)

safety.note: Enclosed, well-lit courtyards with staff and security in the museum wings, busy until late; the cobbles are uneven and icy in winter.

spots.name: Franciscan Monastery Gardens
spots.wikipediaTitle: Franciscan Monastery of the Holy Land in America

safety.note: Enclosed, staffed grounds in a quiet residential neighborhood; daytime only.

spots.name: Bishop's Garden at Washington National Cathedral
spots.hours: daily, daylight hours (check cathedral.org; closes for events)

safety.note: Cathedral grounds with a security presence; the garden is unlit, so leave by dusk.
Open residential park next to a school and Metro; no lighting on the hill, so treat it as a daytime and sunset spot.

Staffed NPS site with a parking lot; it closes at 4pm, so it is daytime only. The nearest Metro is a 15-minute walk away and the dirt pond paths and marsh boardwalk can be empty on a weekday, so drive or bike in if you can, and head back before the gate closes.

spots.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library (rooftop terrace and reading rooms)
spots.wikipediaTitle: Martin Luther King Jr. Memorial Library

safety.note: Staffed public building with security; the downtown block is well-lit and busy in the evening.

spots.name: U.S. National Arboretum (Capitol Columns meadow)
spots.neighborhood: Northeast (off New York Ave / Bladensburg Rd)

safety.note: Gated federal grounds with staff on site; gates close at 5pm, so plan to be out before dusk.

spots.name: Georgetown Waterfront Park
spots.hours: open daily (NPS park); the riverside promenade is used by walkers and runners late into the evening

safety.note: Well-lit promenade with steady foot traffic into the late evening; the darker stretch under Key Bridge is best skipped very late at night.

spots.name: Hains Point (East Potomac Park)
spots.hours: open daily; the Ohio Drive loop is closed to cars at some hours and during events (check NPS)

safety.note: Very quiet and mostly unlit after dark with no Metro nearby; treat it as a sunrise, daytime or golden-hour spot and come by bike or car.

spots.name: Kogod Courtyard (Smithsonian American Art Museum / National Portrait Gallery)

safety.note: Museum security at every entrance and a busy Metro (Gallery Place) directly outside.

Officially dawn-dusk (NPS) and busy right up to closing, but the fountain terraces below the lawn are unlit and the park empties out fast once the light goes. Visit in daytime, or go with friends in the evening and leave by dusk.

spots.name: Politics and Prose (with The Den cafe)

safety.note: Busy, well-lit commercial strip with plenty of foot traffic into the evening.

spots.name: Yards Park
spots.hours: open daily; check yardspark.org for seasonal hours and event closures

safety.note: Well-lit, busy neighborhood park with restaurants and apartments on all sides and regular security patrols.
Unlit and steep; the paths are fine in daylight but go before dusk, since there is no lighting and the motorway footbridge is the only link between the halves.
Steep, unlit bush track with a 45-minute climb and a very exposed summit; go in daylight, carry a light for the descent at golden hour, and turn back in strong wind.

spots.name: National Library of New Zealand
spots.hours: Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-1pm, closed Sun (reading rooms shorter, check site)

safety.note: Staffed government building with security at the door; closes at 5pm, and the surrounding streets are lit and busy with commuters.
Unlit forest tracks that close at dusk; the gully paths are steep and slippery when wet, so go in daylight and stick to the marked trails.
Unlit bush tracks with steep drop-offs and very exposed to wind; the lookout itself is by the road, but go in daylight and stay off the tracks after dark.
Staffed building on the lit waterfront promenade; the wharf edges outside are unfenced.
Village beach with a lit road behind it; the wharf is unfenced and the last ferry leaves early, so plan the trip home.
Staffed cafe that closes mid-afternoon; the beach outside is unlit and the surf is strong, so stay on the promenade after dark.
Staffed and lit until late on a busy pedestrian street; plan the ride home if you stay past the last bus.
Well lit, open sightlines on all sides and a busy road along the northern edge; fine solo in the evening.

spots.name: Te Matapihi ki te Ao Nui (Wellington Central Library)

safety.note: Staffed public building on a central square; lit and busy until closing.
Staffed shop on a busy, lit central street.
Lit promenade with steady foot traffic well into the evening; the beach itself is unlit and the water is cold and unpatrolled outside summer.
Main through-paths are lit and used by commuters after dark; the side tracks in the bush are unlit and steep, so keep to the lit route at night.
